name: NoCopium Trade Journal
author: jlcox1964

sections.description:
NoCopium Trade Journal is a trade journal on your own WordPress site. You type in the trades you care about — stocks, options, futures, and multi-leg structures — then review them with a simple dashboard and a full journal list.

Your fills stay on your server. This is not a SaaS journal that holds your data for you.

Website and Pro: nocopium.com

Live demo: https://nocopium.com/demo/

Help & FAQs: https://nocopium.com/faqs/

How-to pages: Dashboard · Trade Journal · Open New Trade · Settings · Rolling & linked trades

Pro help: Import & tastytrade sync · Analytics

What You Get For Free

  • Log as many trades as you want — no trade cap
  • Options with up to four legs in one trade
  • Name your strategies and keep more than one account
  • Search and filter the journal
  • Roll an open trade from the journal (Roll… / Roll this leg) — log the new Order # and link it without rewriting the opening ticket
  • Linked trades — one journal row for the position, labeled Last while open and Closed as after it closes, with Booked so far or Net P&L; Unlink / Move / Split when you need to fix a link
  • Dashboard with P&L, win rate, equity curve, period gains / return-on-risk charts, and a day-by-day P&L calendar
  • Switch the Free dashboard between this year (YTD) and this month (MTD)
  • Quick glance: how many trades are open, what expires soon, and how this week looks
  • Optional tags: how you felt when you opened (mindset), and whether you followed or broke your plan when you closed
  • Optional buying power / max loss so you can see return on risk when it adds something beyond profit %
  • Export trades to a spreadsheet; back up and restore your journal (onto an empty journal)
  • Load sample trades to explore before you log your own
  • Optional public journal page with [nocopium_journal]
  • Light or Dark look for the admin screens and the public journal

What Free Does Not Include

  • Tastytrade import (read-only sync or manual CSV) — that is Pro
  • Possible Roll flags after import/sync — that is Pro (Free still links rolls by hand from the journal)
  • Deep Analytics (full strategy tables, drawdown, streaks, P&L by plan/mindset, and the Rolling card) over any date range
  • The full dashboard date Range menu (beyond Free’s YTD / MTD)
  • A paid license — Free on WordPress.org needs none

Optional Tags (Mindset & Plan)

When you open a trade, you can note your mindset (for example Disciplined or FOMO). When you close, you can mark Followed Plan or Broke Plan.

The Free dashboard shows a short look at your recent tagged trades. Pro Analytics turns those tags into full reports over the date range you pick. Import does not fill these tags for you.

Your Journal

  • Each trade lives in your WordPress database
  • Common fields: symbol, account, strategy, entry/exit, fees, P&L, notes
  • Optional extras: IVR, VIX, underlying price, buying power, max loss, and more
  • Needs Review marks incomplete rows so they do not skew your stats until you fix them

Dashboard

  • See this year or this month (Free toggle)
  • Equity curve and monthly gains
  • Calendar of green and red days
  • Filter by account when you have more than one

Backup, Export & Public Page

  • Back up / restore from Settings (the destination journal must be empty)
  • Export the journal to a spreadsheet from the Trade Journal page
  • Put [nocopium_journal] on a page if you want a public view (on by default; turn it off in Settings)

Upgrade To Pro

Buy Pro at nocopium.com. Install NoCopium Trade Journal Pro next to this Free plugin. Keep Free installed — your trades stay in the same journal.

Demo: nocopium.com/demo/

Pro adds:

  • Full tastytrade sync — connect read-only, fetch your history, and import all trades into the same journal (no retyping fills). CSV import is there too when you want a manual file upload instead of sync
  • Possible Roll after import/sync — confirm into the same linked-trade flow Free already has
  • Full Analytics (strategy, ticker, plan, mindset, drawdown, Rolling card, and more)
  • A longer date Range menu on the Dashboard and a Profit Factor card

Support

Free: use the support forum on this WordPress.org plugin page.

Pro: support through nocopium.com per your license.

FAQs: https://nocopium.com/faqs/
sections.installation:
1. Install NoCopium Trade Journal from Plugins (or upload the nocopium folder).
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open NoCopium Trade Journal in the admin menu.
  4. Add an account in Settings (or on the welcome screen), then log a trade.
  5. Optional: add [nocopium_journal] to a page to show your journal publicly.
sections.faq:
What does this plugin do?

It is a trading journal inside WordPress. You log options, futures, stocks, and multi-leg trades by hand, then review P&L, charts, and optional tags.

Can I import from Tastytrade?

Not in Free. Pro (sold at nocopium.com) connects to tastytrade with read-only sync and pulls your transaction history into the journal — no typing hundreds of fills by hand. You can also upload a Tastytrade CSV when you prefer a manual import. Free still lets you log every trade by hand with no limit.

Does Pro sync place trades at my broker?

No. Sync only reads past transactions. It never places, changes, or cancels orders.

Can I track mindset and whether I followed my plan?

Yes, in Free. Tag mindset when you open; tag Followed vs Broke Plan when you close. The Free dashboard shows a short summary of recent tags. Full reports over any date range are in Pro Analytics.

Can I track rolled options as one idea?

Yes, in Free. Use Roll… or Roll this leg on an open journal row to log the new Order # and link it. Linked trades show Now legs and net cash so far. Pro can also flag Possible Roll after a tastytrade import or sync so you confirm instead of typing. Details: Rolling & linked trades.

Where is my data stored?

On your WordPress site. You own the server and the data.

Do I need a license for Free?

No. Pro is purchased and activated at nocopium.com.

Can I attach screenshots?

Yes — paste a URL or upload from the Media Library on the trade form.

How do I move my journal to another site?

Use Settings → Backup / restore. Download a backup, install NoCopium on the new site with an empty journal, then restore. Use Export on the Trade Journal for spreadsheets. Screenshot files in the Media Library are not copied in the backup.

More answers: nocopium.com/faqs/
sections.changelog:
1.2.18

  • Admin journal: Status, Opened, Symbol, and Net P&L headers sort the list. The summary strip adds profit factor, average win, average loss, and the current win or loss streak.
  • New Trade: a calendar for the date opened, a searchable strategy picker, and an Expiration field. Imports still fill the expiration from the first leg.
  • Analytics: days to expiration at entry splits into narrower bands, including 0 days and 300+ days for LEAPs.
  • Stats: trades that close at the same time now sort in a fixed order, so drawdown and equity numbers stop moving between page loads.

1.2.17

  • Settings: each account has Show on frontend. Unchecked accounts stay in the admin journal and are left off the public journal, including their trades and totals.

1.2.16

  • Stats for Pro Analytics: average days open by strategy, exit reason, days to expiration at entry, and stated POP versus the win rate on trades that have it.

1.2.15

  • Admin journal: Status, then Opened and Closed with date and time. Days sit under Opened while the trade is open, then move under Closed. Premium is dollars: Paid / Sold for, or Collected / Bought back.
  • Admin roll history matches the public journal: one date and one change per step, with a running net that ends on Net P&L. Order credit, fills, fees, notes, and Unlink / Move / Split stay on each ticket.

1.2.14

  • Public journal: a linked roll stays one row, with opened and closed date and time. Days open sit under Opened while the trade is open, then move under Closed and stop.
  • Public journal: the percent sits under P&L. A closed roll is Win, Loss, or Breakeven from its net P&L.
  • Linked trades: the combined result is Net P&L when closed and Booked so far while open. The position says Closed as after it closes, and Last while it is open.
  • Public roll history: one date and one change per step, with a running net, ending on Closed.
  • Admin journal: a closed linked trade shows Win or Loss, and the position says Closed as (Last while open). Each step still shows that order’s credit.

1.2.13

  • Linked trades: the Opened and Rolled steps show the premium that broker order collected (a roll’s new sale minus its buyback, before fees) instead of the ticket’s later P&L.
  • Linked trades: a roll ticket that was closed later still shows as Rolled.

1.2.12

  • Journal: clearer closed-leg summary strings for translators.
  • Maintenance: PHPCS annotations for backup restore and trade queries.
